caption:
Sub-five hours, fourth overall — my fastest 50K. What the last ten kilometres taught me: the mountain sets the pace, and you decide whether to argue. When you are deep in the Cordillera de Talamanca, the terrain doesn't negotiate. You either move with the incline or you exhaust yourself fighting it. Every kilometre we map for My Adventure Costa Rica is one we have personally run, tested against the same humidity and the same relentless vertical that defines this range.
